This is still happening (Rails 6.0.3.2). The files are in the association, but if you try to access them, you get `ActiveStorage::FileNotFoundError` - even if attached with `#attach`. I guess it is not the same issue as #36716

You might be looking for `config.active_storage.replace_on_assign_to_many = false` configuration which is `true` by default in Rails 6. Setting this to `false` will persist old files when attaching new ones (without providing all the attachments explicitly).
...and how to check for duplicates in this case?

issue.title: Fix #45339 attachments for new record within transaction
issue.body:
### Summary

First attempt to fix #45339 by not using the `change.attachables` on the `#attach` method.

That change was introduced in https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/836eb915b14f01eca8a5ea655e4f30b6a8a7ce38 when fixing #36806 however when reverting the change, the test that was introduced along with it, still passes (except when append on assign).

~We added a new failing test just in case but seems that the bug already existed even before #42300 . So it might be worth tackling it separately.~

cc @georgeclaghorn
